gizmo.title: Chilimbikitso choganizira za iwe wekha
gizmo.description: Funsani wophunzira kuti aganizire za giredi kapena momwe akumvera, ndipo mupereke chilimbikitso chodzikonza malinga ndi yankho.

configure.title: Mtundu wolowetsa
configure.description: Momwe wophunzira amanenera zomwe akuchita. Zonse zimagwiritsa ntchito sikelo ya 0 mpaka 4 (giredi: F=0, D=1, C=2, B=3, A=4; momwe akumvera: pansi kwambiri=0 mpaka zabwino kwambiri=4).

configure.title: Funso
configure.description: Funso la wophunzira. Siyani opanda kanthu kuti mugwiritse ntchito lokhazikika la mtundu wolowetsa.

configure.title: Zilimbikitso
configure.description: Mayankho owonetsedwa pa mayankho osiyanasiyana. Gawo loyamba lofanana ndilo limagwiritsidwa ntchito.
